column1: # Every leg of scripts/git-hooks/pre-push, classified (DEC-597): where it can run, and what happens where it cannot.
# Checked both ways by scripts/test-gate-legs.sh (run by pre-push): a leg missing here, or a row naming no leg, fails.
# key = the text of the leg's `echo "[pre-push] …"` line up to " (" ; columns are TAB-separated.
#   everywhere  runs in every pre-push, PC and cloud (a skip inside it is the leg's own, loud). CI is a separate list:
#               its gate job runs fmt, clippy and the test suite, none of the script suites below
#   owed        may not run where it is; on the PC its script MUST record an OWED entry (scripts/owed-legs.sh) when it
#               does not; in a cloud session it prints the OWED verdict and the PC push after landing records it
#   pc-only     runs on every PC push, before the dk re-exec; a cloud session never runs it, and its work reaches master
#               only through a PC push, which does
#   info        a message, not a leg
